injuries.name: Donovan Ezeiruaku
injuries.note: Ezeiruaku (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: Joey Porter Jr.
injuries.note: Porter (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: DaRon Bland
injuries.note: Bland (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Mingo
injuries.note: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: Devin Moore
injuries.note: The Cowboys designated Moore (hip) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Goodson
injuries.note: Goodson sustained ACL and MCL sprains in his knee during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, a source tells Todd Archer of ESPN.com.

injuries.name: P.J. Locke
injuries.note: Locke (concussion) won't play in Sunday's game against the 49ers, Patrik Walker of the team's official site reports.

injuries.name: Jake Ferguson
injuries.note: According to coach Brian Schottenheimer, Ferguson (knee) is in line to miss multiple weeks, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

injuries.name: Trent Williams
injuries.note: Williams (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injuries.name: Renardo Green
injuries.note: Green (back) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Deommodore Lenoir
injuries.note: Lenoir (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injuries.name: Dre Greenlaw
injuries.note: Greenlaw (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

injuries.name: Mike Evans
injuries.note: Evans (Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Dallas, Nick Wagoner of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: C.J. West
injuries.note: West (knee) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Gracen Halton
injuries.note: The 49ers placed Halton (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injuries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
injuries.note: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
